parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, which is lightweight and flexible.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the frame and rests on the ear to hold the glasses in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, similar to the left leg.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and stability, resting on the right ear to secure the glasses.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or open outward for use.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame Front)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the lens frame and bridge, made of acetate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and provides the main structural support for the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part that does not move, serving as the central structure connecting both legs.
